recommendations.title: Bronx Flat-Fee vs. Percentage Management: The Real ROI on $1,200–$1,800 Rent Buildings
recommendations.what: New post doing the effective-fee-percentage math specifically on Bronx rent levels ($1,200-$1,800), showing how percentage fees eat a larger share of NOI on affordable buildings and how flat-fee stays fixed as taxes/insurance/maintenance rise. Complements (does not duplicate) the existing flat-fee-vs-percentage post which is generic.
recommendations.why: External research identified a clean gap: no competitor calculates flat-fee ROI for affordable Bronx rent levels. The existing generic comparison post has 235 impressions / 0 clicks at position 8.9 — the topic gets served but the generic angle doesn't convert. A Bronx-specific companion targets the missing intent.
recommendations.expectedResult: New page earns 30-80 impressions/month within 60 days and 2-5 clicks; also gives an internal link target to strengthen the existing flat-fee post.
recommendations.metric: impressions + clicks on the new slug
